acceptance: Test: a simulated 503 followed by success makes pr-rerun and the trunk gate succeed.
Test: a persistent 503 fails after the bounded retries with a message naming the endpoint and status.
Test: a 404 fails immediately without retry.
description:
## Problem
On 2026-11-24 `make pr-rerun PR=4491` stopped with "pr-rerun refused: gh pr failed: HTTP 503", and `make pr-arm` stopped with "trunk-arm-gate: refusing: reading PR 4491 failed: HTTP 503". pr-arm's main wait already backs off on transient GitHub failures (pr-arm-github-rate-limit-backoff-20261112), but these two calls do not use that handling.

## Change
Route both calls through the existing transient-retry helper (scripts/gh_transient.py), with the same bounds as pr-arm.

Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create), never the primary clone; heavy test runs only through lock-taking entry points; never set BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK or force admission; stage explicit paths; add a changelog.d fragment if users can see the change; no explanatory comments (make comment-policy-check). Retry only 5xx, rate-limit and network errors, never 4xx; keep retries bounded and within WAIT for pr-arm.
